The Passport v2 API does not use the same authentication and request signing detailed
earlier in this document. Our Python, Go, Java, and Node.JS API clients have been
updated with the new authentication and signing requirements and include support for
the Passport v2 API endpoint. We recommend you use the duo_client_python Python
API client, the duo_api_golang Go API client, the duo_client_java Java API client, or the
duo_api_nodejs Node.JS API client to interact with the Passport v2 endpoint.
